title: Bug tracker support (Sanchit Kapoor, 2016 GSoC)
description: The Hall of Fame project "Bug tracker support" and what the history shows: a first commit in 2016, a relocation into its own project in 2019, and maintenance since.

chapters.title: The Hall of Fame entry
chapters.text: The Student Hall of Fame lists Sanchit Kapoor for "Bug tracker support", GSoC, 2016 Summer, with a link to the add-on. The add-on page is the Bug Tracker page in the ZAP user guide.

chapters.title: 2016: first code in zap-extensions and a helper in core
chapters.text: In zap-extensions, a commit by Sanchit Kapoor dated 2016-05-26 is "Added extension Bug Tracker Phase 1". Its file list includes BugTracker.java, BugTrackerBugzilla.java and BugTrackerGithub.java with their option panels and dialogs, plus the library jars github-api-1.75.jar and j2bugzilla-2.2.1.jar. In zaproxy, a commit by the same name dated 2016-07-01 is "Added abstract class PopupMenuItemAlert for PopupSemiAutoIssue to extend"; it was merged by "Merge pull request #2645 from DarkPrince304/gsocBugTracker" (2016-08-04). A later zap-extensions commit by Sanchit Kapoor, dated 2016-08-27, is "Added help for Bug Tracker add-on".

chapters.title: 2017 to 2019: maintenance, then its own project
chapters.text: "BugTracker Fix Build Warnings" is dated 2017-04-25 and "bugtracker: add task to generate the wiki" 2017-05-26. "bugtracker: remove unused resource message (#1185)" is dated 2017-12-06. On 2019-04-03 the commit "bugtracker: relocate to its own project" adds addOns/bugtracker/bugtracker.gradle.kts and a CHANGELOG.md; the Java file BugTracker.java appears in that commit's stat as a rename-style entry with 0 changed lines.

chapters.title: 2020 to now: dependencies, logging and a PAT
chapters.text: Later commits include "bugtracker: Update Dependency" (2020-04-05), "bugtracker: remove options panels when uninstalled" (2020-06-16), "bugtracker: Use Log4j 2.x" (2021-02-11), "bugtracker: remove usage of custom repository" (2021-05-31), "chore: Bugtracker: Address github library deprecations" (2022-04-09) and "bugtracker: prevent UI init without view" (2024-01-10). The add-on changelog for version 4 (2022-09-23) lists "Updated to use PAT not password". The add-on still exists at HEAD under addOns/bugtracker; its most recent commit touching the changelog is "Help content typo fixes" (2026-11-02).
